source: Marion County surface-water E. coli joined by date to NOAA Indianapolis daily weather
endpoint: E. coli count >=1000 MPN-or-CFU per 100 mL in sampled surface water; project-defined threshold, not drinking-water criterion
information_cutoff: Start of sample day; all meteorological rolling windows exclude the sample day
cdd_assumption: Sum of positive (daily mean Celsius minus 10 C) over previous 10/15 days; ISEF abstract does not specify its degree-day base
selection: Choose family and probability threshold on 2021 July-December by positive F1; evaluate once on 2022
claim_boundary: Public ISEF abstract names six families, weather features and Marion data but omits exact data filtering, threshold, code and split. This is a method reconstruction, not exact replication. The 2022 period was previously inspected for the original NADI logistic baseline, so this is not an untouched project-wide final test.
